message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No credible vulnerabilities newly reported or materially updated in the last 24 hours were confirmed as relevant to the assigned DLL/component inventory.

**Scope**

- Source: `DLL_software_component.txt` only; repeated component names and obvious aliases were normalized and deduplicated.
- `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` were not read or combined with this scan.
- Window: 2026-09-19 13:10 IST through 2026-09-20 13:10 IST (2026-09-19 07:40 UTC through 2026-09-20 07:40 UTC).

**Findings**

No in-window finding passed the freshness, credible-source, and exact product-match checks. The September 19 disclosure set was reviewed against the named .NET/NuGet, JavaScript, document/PDF, data-access, identity, UI, and commercial SDK components. Similar-looking PDF, JSON, Microsoft, and Oracle results affected different products or were published before the cutoff and were excluded.

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector and SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries. MongoDB's official alerts page showed Mongoid advisories dated September 18 and C Driver/Server advisories dated September 17, all outside this run's cutoff; no in-window MongoDB finding was confirmed.

Sources checked included the [MongoDB security alerts page](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), [GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories?query=sort%3Aupdated-desc), [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), NVD-indexed records, vendor advisories, and credible security reporting.

**Review priority**

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported vulnerabilities in this monitoring window. Continue routine monitoring; this result does not assess older known vulnerabilities already applicable to the listed component versions.
